name: count-min-sketch
description: A probabilistic sub-linear space frequency table estimator structure matching streams of items.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to estimate frequencies of items in data streams when memory limits prevent maintaining complete exact tables.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Columns dimensions of the 2D sketches (determines precision estimation range).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Row dimensions / amount of hash functions iterations used.
